column1: # Coverage-derived rRNA blocks for PC9.15. Unlike BOM_ss5, this assembly collapses the
# nuclear rDNA array (those reads multi-map instead of piling into one locus), so only the
# mitochondrial rRNA appears as a discrete unannotated peak -- 60.9% of pooled aligned reads
# in the first block, BLAST-confirmed 100% identity to the P. ostreatus mitochondrion.
